home.wolium.lead: Everything below runs as Discord slash commands, right inside your server. No alt-tabbing required.
home.wolium.outro: More commands land regularly — this list doesn't sit still.
home.wolium.subtabs_lead: Pick Admin or User — I'll show you the commands for that role.
home.wolium.admin.intro: Full moderation toolkit, analytics, server controls — for the people who actually run the place.
home.wolium.admin.analytics.title: Analytics
home.wolium.admin.analytics.message-trac: Every message counted, per member, per channel, over time, stored anonymously. Only the member can delete it, with /delete_data — not even you.
home.wolium.admin.analytics.voice-tracki: Time in voice, tracked per member, stored anonymously. Only they can wipe it, with /delete_data.
home.wolium.admin.analytics.activity-tra: I track your members' Rich Presence — the apps and games they've got open. Stored anonymously, I'm nosy, not a snitch.
home.wolium.admin.analytics.member-join-: I track how your member count moves — the number, and the exact moment it changed.
home.wolium.admin.analytics.graph-comman: A chart, posted straight into the channel. No dashboard required.
Pick a data type (messages or voice), a period (day, week, month, year, all-time), and whether you want this server or your global stats — I'll render the chart as an image, right in Discord.
home.wolium.admin.economy.title: Economy
home.wolium.admin.economy-overview.short: Sparks (₩) aren't tied to your server — the same balance follows a member everywhere I go.
home.wolium.admin.economy-overview.full: I don't do per-server economy — that's on purpose. Every member has one Sparks (₩) balance across every server I'm in: earn it with /work, move it with /transaction. You can't limit or reset it per server, so don't bother looking for the setting.
home.wolium.admin.economy.work.short: Run it every 30 min and I'll pay you Sparks (₩). Boost active? Double payout.
home.wolium.admin.economy.work.full: Run it every 30 minutes and I'll pay you Sparks (₩) — the exact formula's my business. Got a boost active? I'll double it.
home.wolium.admin.economy.transaction.sh: Move Sparks (₩) between your bank and your cash — 100 to 1,000,000 a pop.
home.wolium.admin.economy.transaction.fu: Move Sparks (₩) between your bank and your cash, 100 up to 1,000,000 at a time. Pick the amount and where it's going.
home.wolium.admin.moderation.title: Moderation
home.wolium.admin.moderation.manual-mode: Manual moderation
Server settings
The full control panel for your server, right inside Discord.

The whole control panel, one command. Log channel. AI auto-moderation on/off plus its system prompt. AI chatbot toggle. Word Game and Counting Game setup. Which news updates reach your server (critical, important, regular) and where. Per-channel message TTLs. The website has the same settings, just laid out so it doesn't hurt to look at.
Moderation settings
Flip moderation features on or off, set thresholds, per server.
AI moderation sensitivity, which channels get logged, all of it — one command. Change settings whenever, I don't need a restart to keep up.
Ban a member
Bans someone, reason required, with optional message cleanup or a ban length.

Instantly removes someone so they can't get back in. A reason's required, goes in the audit log — I'm not doing your paperwork for you. You can also clear their recent messages (pick a window, like 1h or 1d) and set a temp ban that lifts itself once it's up.
Kick a member
Removes someone; they can rejoin with a new invite, if you're feeling generous.
One-time removal, not permanent like a ban — they're out now but can crawl back with a new invite. Member and a reason, both required.
Mute a member
Times someone out for however long you decide.

Uses Discord's built-in timeout, nothing extra to set up. Pick a duration and a reason — both required — and I un-mute them automatically once time's up. Max is 30 days, that's Discord's limit, don't blame me.
End a timeout early
Ends a timeout early, if you've had a change of heart.
Unban a member
Undoes a ban so they can come back. Reason required.
Undoes a ban so they can rejoin. Reason required, for the audit log.
Bulk delete messages
Deletes as many messages as you want, in one go — no cap — optionally aimed at one member.

No cap, and no bulk-vs-one-at-a-time choice to make either — I pick whichever method's fastest myself, based on count and message age. Filter it to one member if you're targeting someone specific, add a reason. Type something absurd like 79874928374928 and I'll just work through the entire channel history until there's nothing left.
Bulk delete
Clears a range of messages in a channel in one command. You're welcome.
home.wolium.admin.moderation.reports-pan: Reports show up here, and — if you've set a channel — mirrored in your server too.

When a member reports a message or user, it lands in my own moderation channel by default. Set up a channel on your server and I'll mirror it there too — so you can handle it yourself instead of waiting on my team.
home.wolium.admin.moderation.ai-moderati: I catch rule violations automatically, based on a system prompt you write me.

I read message context instead of just matching keywords, so I catch insults, harassment, and spam a dumb filter would miss. You write the rules yourself, as a system prompt, and I log every action so you can check my work.
I know your whole server and I can act on it — you just have to hit Confirm first. Try to keep up.

Once enabled, I know your whole server — channels, members, past context, all of it. Ask me in plain language: find a user, dig up a message, even take a moderation action, and I'll fill in the details and show you a Confirm/Decline button before I touch anything. I can ban, kick, mute, unban, unmute — but nothing happens until you actually press Confirm. I remember what you and your server tell me, too, so I get more useful the longer you put up with me.
home.wolium.admin.games.title: Games
home.wolium.admin.games.word-game.short: Pick a channel where members build a word chain together.
home.wolium.admin.games.word-game.full: First word's whatever. After that, every word has to start with the last letter of the one before it. Pick the channel in /settings, plus a few more rules if you want it stricter.
home.wolium.admin.games.count-game.short: Pick a channel where your members count upward together, one number at a time.
home.wolium.admin.games.count-game.full: Members take turns posting the next number, starting from 1, climbing as high as the server can manage without messing it up. Admins pick the channel in /settings.
home.wolium.admin.tools.title: Tools
home.wolium.admin.tools.help.short: The full command list, explained, in one place.
home.wolium.admin.tools.help.full: Every command, explained. What I am. Links to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Answers to the questions people keep asking. And the formulas behind stuff like /work that you'd never guess from the description alone.
home.wolium.admin.tools.language.short: Sets the language I reply in — just for you, not the whole server.
home.wolium.admin.tools.format-numbers.s: Pick how numbers look in my commands and on the site.
home.wolium.admin.tools.format-numbers.f: Scientific notation, normal readable notation, or none at all — applies everywhere I show you a number, in a command or on the site. Add an example number to preview it before you commit.
home.wolium.admin.tools.holiday.short: Today's holiday, or the full list I've got memorized.
home.wolium.admin.tools.holiday.full: See today's holiday (I'll tell you if there isn't one) or the whole list I know about. Missing one you want tracked? Tell me on the support server. You can also decide if the reply's just for you or the whole channel.
home.wolium.admin.tools.link.short: Paste a link, I'll show you its full redirect chain, status code for every hop.
home.wolium.admin.tools.translate.short: Translate any message, command or right-click, on the spot.
home.wolium.admin.profile-admin-view.sho: Same profile card members see, except you can look up anyone.
home.wolium.admin.leaderboard-admin-view: Same leaderboards members see, with extra sorting because you asked for it.
home.wolium.admin.faq.title: FAQ
home.wolium.admin.faq.bot-not-responding: That command's probably not translated into your language yet — I'm working on it. Give it 5 minutes and try again. Still nothing? That one's on me, no need to report it.
I'm not responding, or I just say "None"
The provider behind my AI brain is probably down, or I've burned through this month's tokens. Didn't respond after 3–5 tries? That's out of my hands — wait for next month.
home.wolium.admin.faq.bot-error-screensh: Screenshot the error, plus whatever you did right before it happened, even if it seems unrelated. Send it to my support server.
home.wolium.admin.faq.find-channel-id.te: How do I find a channel ID?
home.wolium.admin.faq.find-channel-id.sh: Discord Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode on. Then right-click the channel → Copy Channel ID.

home.wolium.user.tools.translate.short: Right-click any message, or use the command, and I'll translate it instantly.
home.wolium.user.fun.short: Give me any text, I'll post it as my own message. 50 Sparks (₩).
home.wolium.user.fun.full: Type any message — to a specific channel if you want, as a reply if you want — and I'll post it like it's my own words. Costs 50 Sparks (₩). Try to sneak in @here or @everyone and you'll eat a penalty instead: 125 Sparks (₩) from your bank and 125 in cash, 250 total — and the message never sends. Nice try. And go easy on me — whatever you type, I have to say it, so please don't make me the reason someone's feelings get hurt.
home.wolium.user.profile-user-view.short: Avatar, level, XP, balance, messages, voice time — one card. Keep it private or flex it in the channel.
home.wolium.user.profile-user-view.full: Everything I track about you in one card: level and XP progress, currency, message and voice activity, basic server info. You can check someone else's too — but only if your privacy is public, and theirs is too. No exceptions, don't ask.
home.wolium.user.leaderboard-user-view.s: See who's winning at XP, level, messages, voice time, and more. Needs your privacy set to public.
home.wolium.user.leaderboard-user-view.f: Rankings for basically everything I track — total money, XP, level, messages, voice time, vote streaks — scoped to this server, worldwide, or ranked by top servers. Your privacy has to be set to public to see any of it, that part's non-negotiable.
home.wolium.user.privacy.title: Privacy
home.wolium.user.privacy.privacy-setting: Decide exactly what I'm allowed to store about you. Presets or full manual control.

Five categories, each with its own toggle: messages, voice, activity, diagnostics, visibility. Grab a preset — Strict Privacy, Balanced Privacy, Analytics Friendly — or adjust each one yourself if you're picky. Saves automatically, applies right away, and Reset All Settings is there if you change your mind.
home.wolium.user.privacy.delete-data.sho: Deletes your messages and voice data instantly. No confirmation. No undo. Think first.
home.wolium.user.privacy.delete-data.ful: Wipes your stored messages and voice data completely, the second you run it. No confirmation, no undo, no "wait, actually—". Run this on a whim and it's gone forever, like it never happened — I won't stop you, and I won't ask twice. I'll just tell you how many messages and voice sessions didn't make it.
home.wolium.user.privacy.insert-data.sho: Upload your Discord export, get your full message history back.
home.wolium.user.privacy.insert-data.ful: Request your data export from Discord (Settings → Privacy & Safety → Request my data, messages only), wait for the email, then upload the .zip here. I'll swap in the full history from the export — after that your old messages show up in /profile, /graph, and your Profile page on the site, where you can scroll the chart and jump straight to the original message on Discord.
home.wolium.user.report-message.short: Flag a message for the moderators to look at.
home.wolium.user.report-message.full: Right-click any message, or use the command, and I'll send it to the server's report channel — if the admins bothered to set one up. Moderators get the message, the context, and who reported it.
home.wolium.user.report-user.short: Flag someone's behavior for the moderators, not tied to one message.
home.wolium.user.report-user.full: Use this when it's not one message — repeated harassment, a sketchy account, general rule-breaking. Goes to the same report channel the moderators already check.
Servers running me can enable AI and manual moderation — follow the rules, or I will notice.

Don't paste the file contents anywhere, though — that's your personal data. Just say what's happening on the support server and follow whatever they actually ask you for.
